wireContract: Megapot winner send record. Adds POST /rewards/credits/{creditId}/send {recipient, amount_atomic, idempotency_key} and GET /rewards/credits/{creditId}/send, POST /rewards/winner-sends/{sendId}/transactions {transaction_hash}, POST /rewards/winner-sends/{sendId}/cancellation {transaction_hash} and GET /rewards/winner-sends/{sendId}, each returning the signed-in user's reward_winner_send {send_id, credit_id, status: retryable|pending|confirmed|reverted|settled_unverified|cancelled, chain_id, sender, recipient, token_address, amount_atomic, nonce, attempt, transaction_hashes, cancellation_hashes}. The client must sign the ERC-20 transfer (or the zero-value self-transaction for a cancellation) with exactly the returned nonce. A second open send from the same wallet is 409 "Another send from this wallet is in progress". RewardCreditV1 gains a required nullable send {send_id, status}, so Solid must adopt this client before or with the API deploy. All routes are unavailable while Megapot rewards are disabled.
